name: Legate Lanius, Caesar's Ace
oracle_text:
Decimate — When Legate Lanius enters, each opponent sacrifices a tenth of the creatures they control of their choice, rounded up.
Whenever an opponent sacrifices a creature, put a +1/+1 counter on Legate Lanius.
blocked_sentences: Decimate — When Legate Lanius enters, each opponent sacrifices a tenth of the creatures they control of their choice, rounded up.

needs.what: a value expression that divides another value by an arbitrary printed divisor with a printed rounding direction, e.g. {"fraction": {"of": {"count": {"zone": "battlefield", "types": ["Creature"], "controller": {"binding": "each_player"}}}, "divisor": 10, "round": "up"}}, used as the count of a sacrifice selector inside a for_each_player over opponents so each opponent sacrifices ceil(their creatures / 10) creatures of their choice
needs.why_existing_wont_do: The only division in value_keys is `half` ({"half": {"of": v, "round": "up"|"down"}}), fixed at a divisor of 2; `times`, `minus`, `sum`, `min` and `max` cannot compose an exact ceil(n/10) for every creature count, so the sacrifice can only be a fixed number, half or all of their creatures
